segments.title: The strip scrolls clear of the window buttons
segments.body: Horizontal tabs, more than fit. ⌃Tab past the last visible tab scrolls the strip. 0.2.44-nightly.6 slid Top Apps and the tabs under the window buttons; now they're cut off at the strip's edge.

segments.title: The next × stays under the pointer
segments.body: Scrolled to the end, three clicks on the same ×. 0.2.44-nightly.6 shifted the strip after the first close, so the next click selected a tab. Now the next tab's × lands where the pointer is, until you move away.

segments.title: A split tab opens wherever you click it
segments.body: A click near the bottom edge of a split tab in the top strip. 0.2.44-nightly.6 only took clicks on its title and icons, so nothing happened; now the whole pill opens the split.

segments.title: PiP's corners nest in the window's
segments.body: Picture in Picture flung into the corner of a zoomed window. 0.2.44-nightly.6 kept a 6 pt curve that sat off the window's rounded corner; at rest in a corner it now bends to 9 pt, concentric with it.

segments.title: Each profile picks whether it shares Top Apps
segments.body: Settings › Profiles › Shared data. 0.2.44-nightly.6 had one switch for every profile that shares data. Now each has its own: Work opts out and keeps its own Top Apps, while Personal and School still share.
